<div class="card-body">
'''WED-1016 'Techie' Droid''' is a [[Light]] [[Character]] ([[Droid]]) from [[Hoth (Japanese)|Hoth (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">WED-1016 “テッキー（技術屋）” ドロイド</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">惑星の屋外位置かドッキング・ベイにいるなら、各ターンに1回1フォースをロストして同じ位置か隣接位置で武器の命中を受けた宇宙船かビークルを1つロストデッキの代わりにユーズドデッキに移すことができる。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-Hoth-WED-1016-Techie-Droid-PSA-89232349.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">サイボット・ギャラクティカ製宇宙船メンテナンス用ドロイド。5,000種類以上もの装置類を修理できる。反乱軍の機材回収チームが使用している。</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' WED-1016 'Techie' Droid.

'''Card text:'''
If at an exterior planet location or a docking bay, once per turn you may lose 1 Force. Move one starship or vehicle hit by a weapon at the same or adjacent location to the Used Pile instead of the Lost Pile.

'''Lore:'''
A Cybot Galactica starship-maintenance droid. It can repair more than 5,000 kinds of equipment. Rebel salvage teams use it.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' Title adds the gloss （技術屋） for Techie.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[WED-1016 'Techie' Droid]] in [[Hoth (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 43, 103. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
